verdict.rationale: Subscribing to identity events is a fair axis for an identity and admin platform like Google Workspace. However, the evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for user lifecycle or auth events. The Reports API only offers audit reports to view, automatic provisioning syncs accounts to third-party apps rather than delivering event webhooks, and Apps Script is a developer building block, so none of these earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to identity events — webhooks/event hooks fire on user lifecycle and auth events so downstream systems react in real time
